The ideal candidate is both a strategic thinker and highly hands-on — someone who can independently plan, build, run, optimize, and report on campaigns across multiple platforms. Key Responsibilities1. Media Buying & Campaign Management •    Plan, launch, and manage paid campaigns across: –    Meta (Facebook & Instagram) –    Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max) –    YouTube Ads –    TikTok Ads •    Build campaign structures, audiences, bidding strategies, and placements •    Run lead-generation, conversion, remarketing, and retargeting campaigns •    Manage and allocate advertising budgets efficiently across platforms •    Test new audiences, markets, and platforms based on performance data 2. SEO & Search Marketing •    Conduct keyword research for programs, competitors, and target markets •    Optimize website and landing pages for search (on-page SEO) •    Monitor rankings, organic traffic, and Google Search Console •    Align paid search and SEO strategies around high-intent keywords 3. Lead Generation & Enrollment Marketing •    Generate qualified leads, focusing on lead quality rather than engagement alone •    Work with the admissions team to track leads from first click to enrollment •    Improve landing-page and lead-form conversion rates •    Reduce cost per lead and cost per enrollment over time 4. Tracking & Analytics •    Set up and maintain Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, Google Tag Manager, and GA4 •    Configure conversion events, UTM parameters, and attribution •    Implement Meta Conversions API (CAPI), Google Enhanced Conversions, and offline conversion imports from the CRM •    Identify and resolve tracking and measurement issues 5. Reporting & ROI •    Prepare weekly performance reports and monthly ROI reports for university leadership •    Track and analyze key KPIs, including: –    Cost Per Lead (CPL) –    Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) –    Cost Per Click (CPC) and Click-Through Rate (CTR) –    Conversion Rate –    Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) –    Cost per qualified lead and cost per application –    Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) / cost per enrollment –    Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER) / blended ROAS across all platforms –    Video hook rate / thumb-stop rate (TikTok, Reels, YouTube) –    Overall marketing ROI •    Provide data-backed recommendations on budget allocation and scaling •    Prepare monthly forecasts and budget plans 6. Ad Creative Testing & Market Research •    Provide creative briefs and direction to the design and content team based on performance data •    A/B test ad creatives, headlines, and formats, and identify top-performing ads •    Analyze competitor universities' advertising and market trends •    Ensure all ads accurately represent university programs, admissions requirements, and tuition Required Qualifications •    Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field •    Minimum 3 years of hands-on media buying / performance marketing experience •    Proven results managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns •    Practical experience with TikTok Ads and/or YouTube Ads •    Working knowledge of SEO (keyword research, on-page optimization, Search Console) •    Strong understanding of GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels, Conversions API, and server-side/offline conversion tracking •    Experience managing advertising budgets and reporting ROI to management •    Excellent written and spoken English •    Highly organized, self-motivated, and able to work independently Strongly Preferred •    Experience in higher education, online learning, or student recruitment marketing •    Experience targeting U.S. and international audiences •    Experience with CRM systems and marketing automation •    Familiarity with LinkedIn Ads Location Requirement On-site at our Nasr City office (near El Tayaran Street / Al Hay As Sabea). Candidates should preferably live within approximately 30 minutes of the office. The schedule may align with U.S. Eastern Time when required. What We Offer •    Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience •    Performance-based bonus opportunities •    Experience managing campaigns in U.S. and international markets •    Professional development in international higher education marketing •    Opportunities for career growth and advancement Application Process Applicants should be prepared to provide: 1.  An updated CV 2.  A brief summary of their media buying and SEO experience 3.  Examples of campaigns they personally managed, with results (budget, CPL, CPA, leads, ROAS) 4.  A list of advertising platforms they have managed 5.  A sample performance report (with confidential data removed) Apply here: https://windsoruniversity.us/careers/available-jobs/employee-information-form/ English Proficiency Test (free): https://windsoruniversity.us/duolingo/ Interview Process •    Initial online interview to discuss previous campaigns and technical knowledge •    In-person interview at our Nasr City office, usually held on Saturdays •    Applicants can expect a response within approximately one week after completing the required steps Important Note: We are looking for a performance-focused marketer with proven paid advertising results. This role is not suited for candidates whose experience is limited to organic social media management or content posting. Recruitment is conducted on a rolling basis. Early applications are encouraged. Learn more: https://windsoruniversity.us/

review_candidates.title: Digital Campaign/Performance Marketing Specialist
review_candidates.description: We are the platform turning browsing into shopping . We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands. We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases. In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company Flipp, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia. Ready to spark your growth with us? Who We Look For 🦄 We are looking for a Digital Campaign/Performance Marketing Specialist , who will join our Performance Marketing team. As a Digital Campaign/Performance Marketing Specialist , you are responsible for the execution and optimization of digital media campaigns within Flipp’s Private Shopper Network and across external platforms. You will ensure campaigns launch with technical precision, monitor external spend daily to prevent pacing issues, and proactively troubleshoot attribution or tracking discrepancies. To support close collaboration with our Canada-based team & clients operating mostly in Eastern Standard Time, this role will operate on a set schedule of 1:00pm - 10:00pm (Italy local time). We encourage applicants to carefully consider this time alignment as part of their decision to apply. Additionally, please submit your application materials in English . What You Will Do 🏄 Campaign Management and Execution Set up, launch, and manage digital media campaigns across diverse platforms, aligning with business objectives and KPIs. Proactively monitor live campaigns for performance, accurate implementation, and continuous optimization. Collaborate with third-party vendors, and internal sales to communicate campaign performance and drive results. Partner cross-functionally with Content, Operations, Sales, and Analytics to ensure seamless campaign execution and goal achievement. Effectively manage and track client budgets to ensure campaigns achieve target outcomes. Media Planning & Performance Optimization Create media plans, ensuring flight dates, budgets, and channel allocations are accurately documented. Monitor campaign performance and pacing to identify risks and opportunities. Recommend data-driven optimization strategies based on performance trends and established best practices. Implement approved optimization tactics to improve delivery and results. Reporting and Troubleshooting Generate and maintain accurate campaign performance reports on a regular cadence. Review performance data to identify trends, anomalies, or delivery risks. Surface actionable insights to support optimization and performance discussions. Identify and support the resolution of executional, delivery, or data integrity issues in collaboration with senior team members and cross-functional partners. Team & Process Improvement Contribute to the continuous improvement of systems and processes, boosting campaign execution and operational efficiency by sharing learnings and feedback. Collaborate with Product, Sales, Publisher, and other internal & external stakeholders to identify and resolve performance or workflow issues proactively. What You Will Need 🪄 1-3 years working in a relevant industry/position (i.e. digital media agency or news media company) or equivalent practical experience. Strategic & Analytical Capabilities Operational & Technical Execution Relationship & Stakeholder Management 👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you! LOCATION 🌐 While we have offices in Milan, you can benefit from our flexible hybrid model (full remote available), empowering you to work where you're most effective. What You Will Find At Shopfully 🤗 🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company 🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment 🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work 📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions 🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups 🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks 💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are 🧰 Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices Who We Are 💜 We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us. TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯 Progress Over Perfection: We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results. Clarity Through Transparency: We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better. Learn Loudly: We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition. Challenge with Empathy: We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust. Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset. If you choose to apply for this specific job position and submit your application, which may include personal data such as your identifying details, contact information, curriculum vitae, cover letter, professional qualifications, and/or employment history, please be informed that your data may be shared with our Affiliates*, including Offerista Group GmbH and Flipp Operations Inc. The aforementioned entities will act as joint controllers for the limited purpose of intra-group sharing related to the evaluation of candidates’ applications. This means that your data may be processed by the Affiliate to assess your application and, if deemed suitable, to contact you regarding potential employment opportunities. However, please note that from the moment an Affiliate initiates direct contact with you and engages in any further processing of your personal data beyond the initial intra-group sharing for evaluation purposes, such Affiliate shall act as an independent data controller. In such cases, the processing of your personal data will be subject to the specific privacy policies that can be found here. Affiliates shall mean any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by or is under common control with ShopFully SpA and its Affiliates’ subsidiaries, meaning any entity which is directly or indirectly controlled by the Affiliates. How We Support You Our Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure that you are rewarded for impact, take part in accelerated career growth, thrive with highly flexible benefits, and are empowered to do your best work in a remote-first environment. In alignment with our overall Total Rewards Philosophy, we believe compensation should be fair, clear, consistent, and aligned to growth. Italy Base Hiring Range €30.000 - €32.000 EUR

review_candidates.description: ENGIE, compañía global líder en generación de energía y con el propósito de acelerar la transición hacia una economía neutra en carbono, busca un/una Coordinador/a de Ingeniería. En Engie cada talento tiene un rol que cumplir en la aceleración de la transición energética. Marca la diferencia y disfruta de una experiencia profesional gratificante. Enfrenta desafíos apasionantes y construye una carrera que refleje quien eres. ¡Únetenos y se parte de la aventura del siglo! 🎯 Tu propósito en ENGIE Coordinar y liderar proyectos de ingeniería de Transmisión dentro de la Gerencia Técnica, abarcando el área de Soporte Técnico al Desarrollo y el área de Ingeniería, según se le indique desde su jefatura directa o gerencia del área. Con esta flexibilidad sus actividades podrían corresponder a la coordinación y liderazgo de proyectos durante fase de desarrollo y/o Implementación, con el fin de asegurar la entrega de estudios y propuestas, realizando recomendaciones de diseño, revisiones de ingeniería, optimizaciones del CAPEX en los diseños, revisiones de cubicaciones, cronogramas, programación y control de las actividades técnicas durante la fase de desarrollo y/o implementación, validación de equipos primarios previa solicitud de compra, exigencia de cumplimiento según los deadlines o hitos multables del proyecto, considerando los presupuestos asignados y estándares de calidad, normativa nacional e internacional, seguridad, medio ambiente, costos e indicadores definidos por la compañía. 🛠️ Tus principales responsabilidades Analizar y preparar ofertas técnicas y la administrativa (si fuere el caso), y ayudar la documentación (Técnicas y Administrativas, etc.), con el fin de asegurar la participación en los procesos de licitación, manteniéndose coordinado/a con la Gerencia Técnica y con la Gerencia de Implementación de Proyectos, contribuyendo en el desarrollo y estudio de oportunidades de negocio de Tx. Participar en las etapas del desarrollo de proyectos con el fin de asegurar el establecimiento de los alcances, costos, detección de recursos de soporte, plazos y estándares requeridos, con el fin de asegurar el programa de ejecución de proyectos de Licitación o en desarrollo, todo lo anterior alineado con la estrategia y metas organizacionales. Revisar y coordinar los proyectos que le sean asignados del portafolio con el fin de liderar las tareas necesarias durante la fase de desarrollo, implementación o ingenierías Operacionales en su aspecto de ingeniería técnica, utilizando la experiencia interna de la Gerencia Técnico y del grupo Engie, todo lo anterior alineado con la estrategia y metas organizacionales. Coordinar y/o elaborar bases de licitación para contratación de proveedores típicos para la elaboración de productos de ingeniería, controlando y velando por cumplir los plazos establecidos en el cronograma maestro. Trabajar de forma ordenada y según los estándares definidos por la Gerencia de Implementación con el fin de asegurar la correcta trazabilidad y almacenamiento de la información, manteniendo constante interrelación con el área de Proyectos, de Gerencia Técnica, Gerencia de QA&QC, PMO y demás áreas de la organización, actualizado respecto de los requerimientos y modalidades de ejecución de las distintas licitaciones y proyectos. Realizar las funciones, actividades y responsabilidad definidas en reglamento de roles y seguridad RE-01, con el fin de asegurar la aplicación y el cumplimiento de la normativa, reglas y procedimientos internos y externos, contenidos en el programa de seguridad, salud y medio ambiente, en función a las funciones del puesto, y basado a los lineamientos que entrega el IND1, utilizando herramientas de control y reportabilidad definidas por la compañía. ✅ Lo que esperamos de ti Formación académica: Ingeniería en Ejecución / Civil Eléctrica o afín. Conocimiento normativo y del mercado de directa competencia. Conocimientos de Proyectos de Transmisión (calidad de servicio, sistema eléctrico nacional). Conocimientos en Ingeniería Eléctrica de Transmisión. Administración y Optimización de Recursos. Ingles nivel intermedio. Al menos 10 años en cargos similares. Al menos 15 años de experiencia total laboral. 🌟 ¿Por qué ENGIE? Contrato indefinido desde el inicio: Te ofrecemos estabilidad laboral y proyección profesional desde el primer día. Desarrollo profesional: Contarás con un plan de carrera, un equipo altamente capacitado y más de 1.000 cursos en nuestra plataforma Sezame. Beneficios competitivos: Seguro complementario de salud, dental y catastrófico, bono de vacaciones, aguinaldos, días libres adicionales y más. Cultura ENGIE: Diversidad, equidad, inclusión y trabajo colaborativo bajo el modelo ONE ENGIE. 🚀 ¿Te sumas al desafío? Postula ahora y sé parte de una comunidad que impulsa el cambio, innova con propósito y construye un futuro más limpio y justo para todas las personas. Sé un/a Transition Maker en ENGIE. Nuestro compromiso con la diversidad e inclusión. En ENGIE creemos que las grandes transformaciones nacen de la diversidad de ideas, experiencias y perspectivas. Por ello, promovemos una cultura inclusiva donde cada persona puede desarrollarse, aportar su talento y ser auténticamente ella misma. Estamos comprometidos con la igualdad de oportunidades y valoramos a cada persona por sus habilidades, potencial y trayectoria, sin distinción de raza, discapacidad, religión, género, orientación sexual, origen étnico, credo, edad o estado civil. En Engie garantizamos la confidencialidad y seguridad de los datos personales de los/as candidatos. La información proporcionada será utilizada exclusivamente para el proceso de selección y será tratada de acuerdo con la normativa de protección de datos vigente (ley 21.096). Los datos serán utilizados exclusivamente mientras dure el proceso de selección. Al postularte, aceptas el tratamiento de tus datos con estos fines.
